//: Template for SECRETS.json (see issue #10). Copy this file to SECRETS.json and fill in machine-specific values. SECRETS.json is excluded from source control.
//notaryProfile: Name of a notarytool keychain profile used by scripts/create-dmg.sh. Create it once with: xcrun notarytool store-credentials <name> --apple-id you@example.com --team-id D3DPVGA48J --password <app-specific-password>. Only the NAME lives here; the credential stays in the Keychain.
//updatesDir: Local mirror of the web directory published under the app's SUFeedURL, used by scripts/make-appcast.sh. Keeps prior DMGs so Sparkle can compute delta updates. If omitted, a throwaway dir under dist/build/ is used (no deltas).
//sparkle_ed_key_op_ref: 1Password secret reference (op:// URI) for the Sparkle EdDSA private key, read by scripts/make-appcast.sh via the `op` CLI and piped to generate_appcast. Must be signed in to op. Example: op://Personal/Sparkle private key/text
